root.label: Study finds Flock deployment associated with car theft decline

events.label: Study finds Flock deployment associated with car theft decline

slots.name: car theft drop
slots.sentence: They analyzed data from 216 law enforcement agencies that introduced Flock cameras, comparing crime trends with places that had not adopted Flock. They found that deploying Flock cameras was associated with an 11% drop in car thefts in the first year.
